regions.purpose: Names the provider being configured and holds Back to ManageProviders.
One-line read of provider-state — configured / not configured / default — phrased for the specific provider.
Provider-specific setup fields. In google mode: a Paste API key field with Save key action. In osm mode: read-only metadata (endpoint host, attribution).
Cross-provider actions — Set as default — gated on whether the action is meaningful for this provider's current state.
